title: Club Paradise
description: A Chicago firefighter (Robin Williams) and a reggae musician (Jimmy Cliff) turn a Caribbean dive into a swinging-singles resort.

title: The Prince of Pennsylvania
description: A teenager (Keanu Reeves) kidnaps his coal-miner father (Fred Ward), hoping his mother (Bonnie Bedelia) will sell their land for the ransom.

title: Michael Collins
description: An Irish freedom fighter (Liam Neeson) engineers the assassinations of British officials following the failed Easter Rising of 1916.

title: Tequila Sunrise
description: A narcotics officer (Kurt Russell) uses a woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) to catch his buddy, a big-time cocaine dealer (Mel Gibson) ready to retire.

title: Best Friends
description: Hollywood screenwriters (Burt Reynolds, Goldie Hawn), happy as lovers, unwisely get married and go east to meet their in-laws.

title: Pleasantville
description: A shy suburban teen and his sister are transported into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom.

title: Singles
description: A group of young adults in a Seattle apartment building faces a series of romantic crises and catastrophes.

title: New York Minute
description: An uptight teenager (Ashley Olsen) and her laid-back twin (Mary-Kate Olsen) spend a wild day on the streets of Manhattan.

title: Graffiti Bridge
description: The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain."

title: National Lampoon's Loaded Weapon 1
description: A murdered policewoman's replacement (Emilio Estevez) continues a cocaine-cookie case with her ex-partner (Samuel L. Jackson).

title: My Sister's Keeper
description: A girl (Abigail Breslin) who was conceived as a marrow donor for her gravely ill sister goes to court to seek emancipation and prevent further harvesting of her body tissue.

title: Conspiracy Theory
description: An obsessive New York cabby (Mel Gibson), in love with a government worker (Julia Roberts), learns that one of his suspicions is justified.

title: Funny Farm
description: A sportswriter (Chevy Chase) and his wife (Madolyn Smith) move to a cottage in the country, where he tries to write a novel.

title: The Salton Sea
description: An addict (Val Kilmer) works undercover for two police officers and deals with a sadistic dealer (Vincent D'Onofrio) while trying to find his wife's killers.

title: Undisputed III: Redemption
description: Uri Boyka is an inmate trapped in the toughest prison in the world. He is ready to make his comeback in a lethal boxing competition for a shot at freedom.

title: This Boy's Life
description: A hip 1950s teen (Leonardo DiCaprio) butts heads with his mother's (Ellen Barkin) rude second husband (Robert De Niro).

title: Disorderlies
description: A greedy heir (Anthony Geary) hires three inept, rap-singing orderlies (The Fat Boys) to care for his rich uncle (Ralph Bellamy).

title: The Island of Dr. Moreau
description: An English U.N. negotiator (David Thewlis) becomes stranded in the tropics with a mad scientist (Marlon Brando) who makes half-human beasts.

title: Hooper
description: An upstart (Jan-Michael Vincent) pushes a veteran Hollywood stuntman (Burt Reynolds), daring him to try a new stunt.

title: Cannonball Run II
description: J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds), his mechanic (Dom DeLuise) and other veteran competitors enter another cross-country auto race.

title: Almost Heroes
description: A tracker (Chris Farley) and his entourage help a fop (Matthew Perry) try to beat Lewis & Clark to the Pacific Ocean in 1804.

title: The Year of Living Dangerously
description: An Australian reporter (Mel Gibson) betrays his friend (Linda Hunt) and his lover (Sigourney Weaver) in volatile 1965 Indonesia.

title: Rumor Has It ...
description: A woman (Jennifer Aniston) sets out to find the truth after learning that the movie "The Graduate" may have been based on her family.

title: Suburban Commando
description: A warrior (Hulk Hogan) from another galaxy escapes to Earth and moves in with an architect (Christopher Lloyd) and his wife (Shelley Duvall).

title: Honeymoon in Vegas
description: A Las Vegas gambler (James Caan) wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's (Nicolas Cage) bride (Sarah Jessica Parker) during a convention of Elvis impersonators.

title: Presumed Innocent
description: A married prosecutor (Harrison Ford) hires an attorney (Raul Julia) to defend him against charges of murdering his seductive colleague.

title: National Lampoon's Senior Trip
description: To embarrass his rival, a scheming senator (Lawrence Dane) uses nitwit Ohio teens who are invited to a Washington gathering on educational failure.

title: Fracture
description: A hotshot prosecutor (Ryan Gosling) squares off against a cunning engineer (Anthony Hopkins) who tried to murder his wife and is now defending himself in court.

title: Lady in the Water
description: A building manager rescues an enigmatic young woman and learns that she is a "narf," a character from a bedtime story, who is trying to return to her world.

title: Chaos Theory
description: After his wife (Emily Mortimer) plays a prank on him, an efficiency expert (Ryan Reynolds) finds himself subject to the random nature of life.

title: Ghosts of Mississippi
description: A Mississippi prosecutor (Alec Baldwin) and the widow (Whoopi Goldberg) of Medgar Evers crusade to retry a white racist (James Woods) for the 1963 murder of the NAACP leader.

title: Deal of the Century
description: An arms dealer (Chevy Chase), his ex-partner's widow (Sigourney Weaver) and a test pilot (Gregory Hines) sell bad drone aircraft to a dictator.

title: Fandango
description: A prankster (Kevin Costner), an ROTC student (Judd Nelson) and their buddies hop in a Cadillac for one last fling in 1971 Texas.

title: Transcendence
description: A scientific genius's (Johnny Depp) controversial attempts to create a sentient machine take an unforeseen turn after he is mortally wounded during an attack by anti-technology radicals.

title: Spies Like Us
description: Two clumsy bureaucrats (Chevy Chase, Dan Aykroyd) are trained as spies, then sent to Pakistan to create a diversion.

title: Alex & Me
description: Teenager Reagan Wills dreams of playing soccer like Alex Morgan, her hero. A poster of the soccer star magically comes to life in Reagan's bedroom, and Alex helps Reagan learn the value of determination.

title: Surf Ninjas
description: Two California surfers (Ernie Reyes Jr., Nicolas Cowan) try to overthrow a dictator as long-lost princes of a place called Patu San.

title: The Corruptor
description: An NYPD recruit (Mark Wahlberg) and his superior (Chow Yun-Fat) work to dampen the war between Triads and Dragons in Chinatown.

title: Dark City
description: A demented genius (Kiefer Sutherland), a sympathetic detective and a group of ominous beings are drawn to an amnesiac (Rufus Sewell) accused of murder.

title: Executive Decision
description: A commando squad must conduct a midair assault upon a hijacked plane loaded with terrorists and a deadly nerve gas.

title: After the Sunset
description: An FBI agent (Woody Harrelson) thinks a master thief (Pierce Brosnan) and his girlfriend (Salma Hayek) will try to steal a valuable diamond from a cruise ship.

title: Joe Versus the Volcano
description: A dying man (Tom Hanks) meets three women (Meg Ryan) on his way to Polynesia, where a tycoon (Lloyd Bridges) expects him to jump into a volcano.

title: The Adventures of Pluto Nash
description: A nightclub owner finds himself in hot water when he refuses to sell his club to the local mob; the lunar gangsters are helping the mysterious Rex Crater mastermind a plan to take over the moon.
